arms.direct_full: D_full from all m audited outcomes
arms.shared_audit: (1-w_full)*D_full + w_full*H, with w_full computed from D_full
arms.strict_A_to_B: w_A from A; estimate uses D_B
arms.strict_B_to_A: w_B from B; estimate uses D_A

audit_design.half_split: shuffle sampled indices with same replicate RNG; first m/2=A, second m/2=B
audit_design.sampling: simple random sample without replacement from frozen eligible target roster

losses.primary: Monte-Carlo MSE of performance estimate around full eligible-target accuracy theta

mechanism.primary_prediction: role separation reduces absolute exact directional coupling relative to shared-audit

primary_mechanistic_gate.per_target: for each target separately, strict_mean reduces |coupling| in at least 3/4 budgets AND crossfit reduces |coupling| in at least 3/4 budgets
primary_mechanistic_gate.pooled: median signed reduction in |coupling| is positive for strict_mean and crossfit across all 8 target-budget cells
